title: Substitute a function body at a call
description: You can follow the supplied inliner on a small named function.

steps.description: Lambda stores a parameter and body. App stores a function expression and argument alongside the arithmetic node forms.
substitute replaces matching variable occurrences. It stops within bodies where the same name is shadowed; it supplies no binder-renaming case.
inline looks up named functions and checks their body size. For an eligible call, it substitutes the transformed argument and visits the resulting tree.

steps.question: What replaces the two x occurrences when double receives Num(5)?
steps.answer: Num(5) replaces each occurrence, producing an addition of two fives.

steps.description: pretty renders the original call and transformed tree. The first display changes double(5) to (5+5).
The second display changes double((3+2)) to ((3+2)+(3+2)). Further constant folding appears only in a comment, not as an executed transformation.
